patch_description:
This replaces the purely random construction with a deterministic bottleneck-oriented coordinate search. Four points are fixed at the corners of the unit square, guaranteeing a convex hull of area one and making the normalized minimum triangle area equal to the raw minimum area. The remaining nine points are optimized through multiple seeded restarts.

The search uses a smooth lower-tail objective: rather than optimizing only the single worst triangle, it emphasizes the collection of smallest triangle areas using a temperature-controlled soft minimum. This avoids unstable behavior where improving one degenerate triangle immediately creates another. Candidate moves are evaluated in batches while only recomputing triangles incident to the moved point, making the optimization substantially more efficient than recalculating all geometry for every proposal.
